summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Lorenzo Thomas, a career United States Army officer who served as Adjutant General of the Army at the start of the American Civil War. After the war, President Andrew Johnson appointed him temporary Secretary of War, an appointment that precipitated Johnson's impeachment. The entry gives his birth and death dates but little else.
one_line: Lorenzo Thomas was a 19th-century U.S. Army officer, Adjutant General at the start of the Civil War, whose appointment as temporary Secretary of War precipitated Andrew Johnson's impeachment.
key_facts: Lorenzo Thomas was a career United States Army officer.
Lorenzo Thomas was Adjutant General of the Army at the beginning of the American Civil War.
After the American Civil War, Lorenzo Thomas was appointed temporary Secretary of War by U.S. President Andrew Johnson.
The appointment of Lorenzo Thomas as temporary Secretary of War precipitated the impeachment of President Andrew Johnson.
